name: Price Report Correction V 03
definition: Scope|A report provider, eg, a transfer agent, fund accountant or market data provider, sends the PriceReportCorrection message to the report recipient, eg, a fund management company, transfer agent, market data provider, regulator or any other interested party to correct at least one of the prices for a financial instrument that was reported in a previously sent PriceReport message.|Usage|The PriceReportCorrection message is used to correct information reported in a previously sent PriceReport.|If an entire PriceReport message must be corrected, eg, due to an incorrect trade date, it is recommended that a PriceReportCancellation message is used to cancel the entire PriceReport message and a new PriceReport sent.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Reference that uniquely identifies a message from a business application standpoint.

PoolReference.name: Pool Reference
PoolReference.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

PreviousReference.name: Previous Reference
PreviousReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously sent.

PriceCorrectionDetails.name: Price Correction Details
PriceCorrectionDetails.definition: Information related to the correction of a price of a financial instrument.

PriceCorrectionRepeatRule.definition: All information that was sent in a Price Report message should be repeated in the Price Report Correction message. Only price information that has been corrected should be quoted in CorrectedPriceDetails.
